summary: Half in near the October low: the trend is still down, but much of the fall has already happened.
reasons: Nifty is below its 200-day average and the 50-day average is below the 200-day, so the trend is down.
Nifty is about 14% below its January high and close to its 8 Oct low of 22,232.
A half position gets part of any rebound without betting everything.

summary: Holding half: Nifty bounced above the October low, but the trend is still down and oil is a big risk.
reasons: Neither trigger was hit: Nifty closed at 22,753, above 22,000 and below its 50-day average (about 23,370).
Nifty rose 0.68% after four straight falls and held well above the 8 Oct low of 22,232, but it is still 5.6% below its 200-day average.
Brent crude above $114, the rupee near 95 per dollar, heavy foreign selling in October and the US Fed decision on 28 Oct are big risks.
Breadth is still weak: 443 stocks hit 52-week lows today against 20 new highs.
go_fully_in_if: Nifty closes above its 50-day average (about 23,370, falling)
